newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Three Brazilian banks started.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Three Brazilian banks started.

text.p: Societe Generale analyst Yolanda Courtines has started coverage of Brazil's Banco Itau SA and Unibanco with ratings of buy.
-- In a July 18 report, Courtines also started Banco Bradesco with a rating of outperform.
-- Brazilian banks "are among the most attractively priced in the region based on their earnings-generating capacity and understated book values," she wrote.
-- She set a 12-month price target of $720 for Itau, $52 for Unibanco and $11.70 for Bradesco, suggesting potential increases of 36 percent, 36 percent and 20 percent, respectively.
